FORM 3
G. 40M - 38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
Section 1, Special Br. Station,
REPORT    Date April 26, 19 38.
Subject (in full) Miss MARGARET DOREEN SCOTT - communication from Messrs.
Lloyd Triestino dated 21st April, 1938.
Made by...R.S...Henchman................Forwarded by...C. Coafar...

Enquiries made with a view to ascertaining the present
whereabouts of Miss M. D. Scott show that this lady is employed
in the capacity of receptionist by Dr. M. E. Klatchko, 26
The Bund, at which address she also resides.
Miss Scott is reported to be Russian by birth and though
she claims British nationality she is not registered at the
British Consulate.
Enquiries at both the U.S.A. Consulate and at the offices
of the Russian Emigrants' Committee have produced negative
results.

D.C. (Special Branch)
D. S.

表格 3
G. 40M - 38

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号...........
特务科第1股，
报告    日期 1938年4月26日。
事由（全称）玛格丽特·多琳·斯科特小姐（Miss MARGARET DOREEN SCOTT）——劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司（Messrs. Lloyd Triestino）1938年4月21日来函。
制作人...R.S...亨奇曼（Henchman）................转呈人...C. Coafar...

为查明 M. D. 斯科特小姐目前下落而进行的查询显示，该女士受雇于外滩26号的 M. E. Klatchko 医生，担任接待员，并居住于该地址。
据报斯科特小姐出生于俄罗斯，尽管她声称拥有英国国籍，但并未在英国领事馆登记。
在美国领事馆及俄国侨民委员会办公室进行的查询均未获结果。

特务科副督察
D. S.

G=F/F24/1743

21st April 1938.

MAJOR K. M. BOURNE, I.C.
DEPUTY COMMISSIONER,
SPECIAL BRANCH,
185, FOOCHOW ROAD,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir,

MISS MARGARET SCOTT.

Miss Margaret Scott travelled from Shanghai
Hong Kong by our m/v "Victoria" 15th February 1938 as a
clandestine passenger, and had to be repatriated at the
request of the Police Authorities of Hong Kong. Our
Company had to provide her with a passage by s/s
"Conte Verde" which arrived here on 28th February 1938.

As we wish to communicate with this lady we
shall thank you if you can supply us with her address
the same being unknown to us.

Thanking you for your attention, we remain,

Yours faithfully,
LLOYD TRIESTINO
AGENZIA GENERALE DI SHANGHAI

D.S. Hershman
（批：C 3/4）

尊敬的先生：

玛格丽特·斯科特小姐。

玛格丽特·斯科特小姐于1938年2月15日作为偷渡乘客，乘坐我方“维多利亚”号机动船（m/v "Victoria"）从上海前往香港，并应香港警方当局要求被遣返。我公司不得不为其提供乘坐“绿伯爵”号蒸汽船（s/s "Conte Verde"）的舱位，该船于1938年2月28日抵达此地。

因我方希望与该女士取得联系，若蒙告知其地址（我方目前不知），将不胜感激。

感谢您的关注，此致，

您忠实的，
劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司
上海总代理处

April          27          38.

A. S. Heaney, Esq.,
Passport & Registration Office,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have received a letter from Messrs.
Lloyd Triestino inquiring for the address of a
Miss Margaret Scott and have referred them to you
for the desired information. I attach copy of
letter from Lloyd Triestino, my reply thereto dated
April 27, 1938, and copy of report containing the
address of Miss Scott.

I am,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)
pages.zh:
1938年4月27日。

A. S. Heaney 先生，
护照与登记办公室，
英王陛下驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

先生，

我收到劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司来函，询问玛格丽特·斯科特小姐的地址，我已请他们向您寻求所需信息。随函附上劳埃德·特里埃斯蒂诺公司来信副本、我于1938年4月27日作出的回复副本，以及包含斯科特小姐地址的报告副本。

我是，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

副总监
（特务科）
